design: powered paired replication of one-step vs two-step Bayesian proposal lookahead
primary_metric: paired two-step minus one-step edge error
interpretation: Two-step lookahead shows no statistically resolved improvement on the preregistered edge-error metric at n=48. It produces a higher MAP hit rate but also significantly greater posterior entropy. Search-depth effects remain confounded by stochastic proposal generation and RNG consumption in planning simulations.
next: EXP-002F matched-depth ablation with isolated RNG streams and identical proposal-generation randomness so the only intended treatment difference is lookahead depth.
